name: img-vid-generation
description: AI image and video generation app — Next.js frontend + FastAPI backend monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c blue,green,yellow --kill-others "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:worker: uv --directory apps/api run celery -A app.tasks worker --loglevel=info
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.gen:api-types: uv --directory apps/api run python -m app.openapi_export > packages/shared-types/openapi.json && openapi-typescript packages/shared-types/openapi.json -o packages/shared-types/api.d.ts
